verdict.rationale: Smithery is an MCP registry and connection platform. A platform like this could plausibly offer built-in AI insights on a user's usage or data, so the axis applies. The evidence covers OAuth handling, credential storage, publishing, triggers and CLI tool search, but nothing describes AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from the user's own data inside the product. Third-party servers it hosts (e.g., Exa's deep research) and intent-based tool search are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
